title: Work out session expiry in one place
prompt: The session lifetime sum (`now + sessionTtlSeconds`) is written out inline in createSession in auth/sessions.ts, and we are about to need it in more places. Move it into an exported helper `sessionExpiry(ctx, from?)` in the same file that returns the ISO timestamp one session lifetime after `from` (default: now, from the context's clock), and use it in createSession. Behaviour must not change.
